primitives.name: Binary Prop Uncertainty Quantification Calibration
primitives.verbatim_quote: 2109.12464 | KEEP | Method wire-ready now for binary prop UQ calibration.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x_i': 'Binary outcome indicator (0 or 1)', 'n': 'Number of trials (dimensionless)', '\\hat{p}': 'Maximum likelihood estimate of success probability (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Bernoulli trials with constant success probability, independent observations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Small sample sizes or extreme probabilities (p near 0 or 1) lead to unreliable variance estimates.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's posterior predictive uncertainty via conformal prediction intervals, ensuring empirical coverage guarantees for binary event forecasts.
layer2.telemetry: Calibration error on holdout test sets, measured as difference between predicted probability and observed frequency.

primitives.name: Opponent-Adjusted Performance Metrics
primitives.verbatim_quote: 2604.01491 | KEEP | Method wire-ready now for opponent-adjusted NFL performance metrics.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'O_{ij}': 'Observed performance of player i vs opponent j (dimensionless)', 'E_{ij}': 'Expected performance based on league average and opponent strength (dimensionless)', 'S_{ij}': 'Standardized performance residual (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: League-wide linear additive models, normally distributed residuals, and exchangeability of players across opponents.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-stationary opponent quality or structural breaks in team composition cause bias in expected values.

layer2.mapping: Dualizes to GSE's state-transition models where performance deltas drive action probabilities, enabling multi-step lookahead.
layer2.telemetry: Out-of-sample predictive accuracy on holdout validation sets, cross-validated over different time periods.

primitives.name: Joint Outcome Calibration
primitives.verbatim_quote: 1710.05284 | MEASURE | Test joint-outcome calibration against NFL market close mu.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mathbf{X}': 'Vector of joint outcome random variables (dimension depends on outcomes)', '\\Sigma': 'True covariance matrix (units depend on outcome variables)', 'Cov(\\mathbf{X})': 'Sample covariance matrix estimator (same units as \\Sigma)'}
primitives.assumptions: Multivariate normality of outcomes, finite second moments, and ergodic stationarity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Heavy-tailed distributions or tail dependencies violate normality, causing miscalibration in joint quantiles.

layer2.mapping: Embeds into GSI's multivariate conformal framework to generate marginal and conditional coverage simultaneously.
layer2.telemetry: Multivariate calibration score such as spherical coverage and refinement on test data.

primitives.name: Spread-to-Probability Conversion
primitives.verbatim_quote: 2212.08116 | MEASURE | Test spread-to-probability conversion accuracy on NFL betting data.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'s': 'Point spread (betting line) in points (dimensionful)', '\\sigma': 'Residual standard deviation of point differential (same units as s)', 'P(W)': 'Win probability under symmetric Gaussian noise (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Symmetric Gaussian distribution of point margins, no systematic bias, and stable variance across games.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Skewed score distributions or heteroscedasticity cause systematic under- or over-estimation of win probabilities.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE's risk-neutral measure calibration, where spreads become martingale drifts in sequential decision trees.
layer2.telemetry: Brier score or log-loss on out-of-sample win probability predictions, stratified by margin size.
